dedupe_keys.name: slovenia consolidated cadastre of public utility infrastructure zk gji national geopackage and csv downloads of roads railways electricity gas heat water supply sewers electronic communications and other networks updated weekly

description: The Surveying and Mapping Authority of Slovenia (GURS) keeps the consolidated cadastre of public utility infrastructure (Zbirni kataster gospodarske javne infrastrukture, ZK GJI), a central register into which every infrastructure network manager must report its objects, and offers national extracts on the e-prostor download portal. Contents: one download per network type for the whole country, namely roads (about 102 MB), railways, airports, harbours, cable railways, electricity (about 254 MB), natural gas (69 MB), heat (12 MB), oil and oil products, water supply (170 MB), sewers (110 MB), waste management, water infrastructure, facilities of the Slovenian Environment Agency, electronic communications (769 MB), sports and leisure facilities, standalone parking areas and other infrastructure; each object has its type, location, identifier and network manager, and a separate product gives network termination points. Producer: GURS, from data submitted by all public infrastructure managers. Coverage: the whole of Slovenia. Format and access: ZIP files with GeoPackage geometry and CSV attributes (UTF-8), regenerated weekly (extracts dated 26 September 2026 at the time of checking), downloadable without registration from the e-prostor portal, with a data structure workbook and metadata in the national catalogue. Licence: free of charge under the GURS general terms for the use of geodetic data (attribution). Caveats: completeness depends on what each manager has reported, positional accuracy varies by source, and attributes describe object type and manager, not capacity or condition. Simulation uses: rare national multi-network dataset for interdependency and cascading failure studies, co-location of buried utilities, exposure of water, sewer, gas and power networks to floods and landslides, and digital twin baselines. Related records: AKOS geoportal and registers (data-akos-geoportal-eanalitik-and-registers-slovenia) and DRSI state road traffic counts (data-drsi-slovenia-state-road-traffic-counts).
